rule: Do not count these publications as independent replications; exact component matching remains a source-registration/governance review task.
One-day and one-week experiments remain distinct contrasts; source reused for direct belief and reasoning does not add independent evidence. Broader science correction differs in estimand.
Same Tversky/Kahneman work in different canonical source records; preserve IDs but do not count twice. No canonical register repair.

Reused SRC-433 after full-register title detection. Candidate metadata records publisher authors; canonical attribution conflict remains visible and unmodified. Provisional number 0006 must not be reassigned.
Reuse canonical SRC112; provisional number 0008 is retired, never reassigned. Conceptual critique is not empirical causal evidence.
Same framework paper, no empirical causal replication; preserve both canonical IDs.
2006 psychometric paper reuses N149 CET trial and adds N199; not two independent replications of the 2003 intervention effect.

Bigsby reports 54% of Tannenbaum sample included and 15 new group comparisons. Six-study factorial behavioral review differs from broad fear outcomes; successful-manipulation selection differs from all risk-message trials. No pooling/independence claim.
Four of seven legitimacy evaluations in Mazerolle 2013 are from the RISE conferencing experiment. Do not count seven independent replications or transfer trust/compliance outcomes to legitimacy.

Hartgerink review search ended 2013 and excludes manipulation checks; 2022/2025 primary findings postdate it. Do not count the broad pooled outcome as an additional exact exclusion-rating replication.
Different feedback comparisons, populations and follow-up windows. No pooled effect or independent component efficacy; indirect/reverse mediation and downstream null remain separate.
Preserve prior SOC-F07 duplicate-component flag: SRC509 bundles Centola 2010 (also SRC235) with a separate review. This is not two replications or generic evidence of trust/norm perception.
Same da Costa et al. 2023 work DOI 10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1096877; author attribution issue retained without canonical correction. One review, not two independent replications.
SRC-CAND-PSY-LAYER-0040 retired in favor of existing Sailer/Homner canonical SRC-467 after complete register DOI check; no new registration.
Patall 2008 choice synthesis includes Reeve 2003; separately extracting its null is not independent replication. Patall 2010 published after review.
Homework units, repeated measures, multiple IMI outcomes and correlational Analysis 2 are the SAME students, not separate trials. Preserve outcome-specific missingness.
Reward syntheses substantially revisit same literature with differing task/inclusion/contingency aggregation. No independent replication count or majority vote.
Later anticipated-regret synthesis may contain studies from earlier TPB augmentation synthesis; overlap not fully enumerated, no independence assumed.
State pre/post, active comparator, PANAS/respiration and trait outcomes share NCT05304000 participants; no independent replication or cross-outcome inference.
Affect induction reviews and older film studies may share components; exact overlap not enumerated. Treat as dependent/uncertain, no replication count or pooled causal weight.
Compassion/meditation syntheses have different inclusion/constructs and potentially overlapping trials; active-control differences not independent votes.
Coherent placebo trial is later than February2022 review search; review result not evidence for that exact operation or DASS/PSS equivalence.
Version2 Crossref publication2025 versus original2024 report; versions and corrections are one replication dataset, not independent studies.
WM and n-back training syntheses may share primary trials; near/far-transfer contrasts and repeated outcome estimates are not independent replication.
Cue/signaling syntheses cover overlapping literature. Learning, load and gaze outcomes cannot be summed as independent causal contributions; meta-regression not mediation.
Mindfulness syntheses differ in inclusion/comparator/outcome definitions; shared studies and preprint/journal versions are not replication. Accuracy/latency and active-control differences preserved.
SRC171 stored PMID duplicates SRC125 review, while title names a2007 experiment included in Meyer2015 replication analysis. Preserve identity conflict and original-study inclusion.
Roediger experiments have separate participants, but repeated outcomes/intervals are not independent replications; Rowland review may include them, component overlap not enumerated.

Current/retrospective certainty and accuracy/calibration outcomes are not independent samples. Intended Wixted/Wells synthesis may reuse primary work; storedSRC184 PMID instead resolves unrelated sleep source.
Schacter review discusses original Google experiments/replications. Priming failure not automatically a storage-expectation null; neither review nor multiple outcomes add independent evidence.
SRBAI contains SRHI items; longitudinal studies may be included in later review. Pre/post change, automaticity/habit scores and components are not independent randomized replications.
Original, exact replication, different-task null and overtraining failures have distinct estimands; invalid control devaluation is not equivalent to a supported-null stress effect.
Source120 stored bibliography mismatches its2008 PMID;2007 and2008 study overlap not established. No independent count, causal mediation or identical goal/association estimand inferred.
App commitment+prompts and action+coping planning are packages; component claims cannot inherit joint efficacy. Review inclusion/online dates must be checked before independence.
High/low cue conditions may be relabeled placebo/nocebo across studies; pain and expectancy outcomes share samples. No replicated claim count or causal mediation from pooled association.
